markdown_to_html

markdown_to_html — parse a Markdown source string and return the HTML, GFM-flavored (tables, strikethrough, tasklists, bare-URL autolinks — the marked.use({ gfm: true }) bundle).

Extensions

  • ENABLE_TABLES — pipe tables, the | a | b | + |---|---| delimiter form marked renders into <table><thead><tbody>.
  • ENABLE_STRIKETHROUGH — ~~gone~~ → <del>.
  • ENABLE_TASKLISTS — - [ ] item → <li><input disabled type="checkbox">.

Plus the event-stream bare-URL autolinker above — marked's gfm autolink parity that pulldown's ENABLE_GFM flag doesn't cover (it gates [!NOTE] blockquote alerts instead, which marked never produced, so that flag stays OFF for parity).

Footnotes, smart punctuation, math, superscript/subscript, wikilinks, and heading attributes stay OFF — marked never enabled them, so enabling them here would silently change output for syntax that previously rendered as literal text.

  • @param source The Markdown source text.
  • @returns The rendered HTML string.
